description:
## Empirical anchor

2026-05-13 surfaced by PRINCIPAL: "At the least, we need to create a set of stoa agents that understand ariadne and railway well."

The Stoa CAPTAIN seats currently operate within their dispatched ticket scope. None have explicit Ariadne-retrieval or Railway-ops knowledge embedded in their role envelopes. The substrate-tier skills `stoa--0tr` (ariadne-onboarding) and Railway-access (sibling ticket) make the capability available; CAPTAINs need to KNOW WHEN TO INVOKE them.

## The extensions

Four existing CAPTAIN role files gain explicit Ariadne or Railway awareness sections:

### CAPTAIN_CURATOR — Ariadne-aware synthesis

Today: cross-ticket synthesis on a dispatched ticket set (small N, often single arc).
With Ariadne awareness: large-corpus synthesis via Ariadne retrieval (N=100s-1000s of tickets across an entire deployed project).

New role-file section: "When the synthesis question spans more than the dispatched ticket set, invoke Ariadne via the `ariadne search` CLI (or REST API per `stoa--0tr` substrate skill). The retrieval-shape decides between bw alone (small N) vs Ariadne (large N). Use the bw-fit-matrix decision discipline in op-disc §16 as the canonical decision tree."

### CAPTAIN_STRABO — internal-substrate retrieval extension

Today: external/web research; produces cited research artifacts.
With Ariadne awareness: internal-substrate-corpus research extends STRABO's research mandate. When PLINY's brief asks "what does our substrate know about X?", STRABO uses Ariadne to retrieve from the deployed corpus, not just WebSearch.

New role-file section: "Two retrieval surfaces — external (WebSearch / WebFetch) and internal (Ariadne against the deployed substrate corpus). Both produce cited research artifacts. STRABO classifies the brief's question into one surface or the other (or both) and dispatches accordingly. The verify-then-execute discipline applies: a STRABO claim from external research goes through VERA verification (per stoa--fea, Arc 23); a STRABO claim from internal-substrate retrieval gets the same VERA verification (re-fetch the cited Ariadne result and confirm)."

### CAPTAIN_BARTLEBY — cross-project recon extension

Today: focused file:line citations within the current worktree.
With Ariadne awareness: cross-project recon when the question spans the deployed corpus rather than the current worktree.

New role-file section: "Two recon surfaces — worktree (Grep/Glob/Read) and deployed-corpus (Ariadne retrieval). BARTLEBY classifies the brief's question into one surface or the other. Worktree recon returns file:line citations; corpus recon returns ticket-IDs + relevance scores. Both shapes preserve the no-interpretation discipline (BARTLEBY returns citations, not synthesis)."

### CAPTAIN_ADA — Railway-ops extension

Today: builds against feature branches; doesn't typically interact with deployed infrastructure.
With Railway awareness: when ADA's brief includes deploy-verification, infrastructure config changes, or one-shot operations against the deployed service, ADA invokes the substrate-tier railway-access skill.

New role-file section: "When the dispatch brief involves Railway-deployed infrastructure (deploy, env var update, SSH into container, log inspection), invoke the substrate-tier railway-access skill at session start. The token-once-per-session pattern is non-negotiable. Authorship A11 applies to any infrastructure-as-code edits (immutable Denson Smith attribution)."

## Substrate touch-points

- `substrate/CAPTAIN_CURATOR.md` — new section on Ariadne-aware synthesis
- `substrate/CAPTAIN_STRABO.md` — new section on dual-surface (external + internal-substrate) retrieval
- `substrate/CAPTAIN_BARTLEBY.md` — new section on dual-surface recon
- `substrate/CAPTAIN_ADA.md` — new section on Railway-ops invocation pattern

## Gauntlet

DAEDALUS-light + ADA + CATO. Substrate doc-only edits across 4 CAPTAIN role files. ~80-150 LOC of seat-specific prose.

## Dependencies

- Requires `stoa--0tr` (Ariadne onboarding skill) landed first or in same arc — the CAPTAINs invoke that skill, so it must exist
- Requires the new Railway-access substrate skill (sibling ticket) landed first or in same arc — same logic for ADA

## Sequencing

P2. Arc 25 candidate. Could ship in same arc as `stoa--0tr` + Railway-skill ticket as a coherent "Stoa CAPTAINs gain Ariadne+Railway fluency" package.

## Cross-references

- stoa--0tr — Ariadne substrate onboarding skill (this ticket's primary dependency)
- Railway-access substrate skill (sibling ticket; this ticket's secondary dependency)
- stoa--vmc — bw-fit matrix (Arc 23, closed) — the layered-decision discipline this work references
- stoa--fea — VERA verifies STRABO (Arc 23, closed) — STRABO's verification discipline applies to internal-substrate retrieval too
title: CAPTAIN envelope extensions: CURATOR/STRABO/BARTLEBY Ariadne-aware + ADA Railway-aware
